sections.heading: Description
sections.text:
Pot Noble Harunaga (壺の貴人・春長) is a merchant who trades items for Treasure Carp Scales.
Obsessed with becoming a carp, he was banished from the Fountainhead Palace for trying to kill the Great Coloured Carp and will now bestow his Truly Precious Bait upon Wolf to complete the job.
If Sekiro feeds Harunaga's Bait to the Carp, the Pot Noble will turn into a Red-Eyed Treasure Carp, while his rival Koremori will disappear.

sections.heading: Location
sections.text: - Dragonspring - Hirata Estate: to the right of the bridge coming from the Sculptor's Idol, near a stretch of land.

sections.heading: Hirata Estate (Dragonspring - Hirata Estate)
sections.text: Spend 3 or more Treasure Carp Scales to unlock the "Talk" option.

sections.heading: Hirata Estate (Dragonspring - Hirata Estate)
sections.text: Give Harunaga at least 3 more Treasure Carp Scales and talk to him to receive his Truly Precious Bait.

sections.heading: Fountainhead Palace ( Feeding Grounds )
sections.text: Feed Harunaga's Bait to the Great Coloured Carp.

sections.heading: Hirata Estate (Dragonspring - Hirata Estate)
sections.text: Lapis Lazuli [x1] will now be found in Harugana's pot, while the Noble will have turned into a carp and inherited the whole stock of the other Pot Noble, who'll disappear from the game for the rest of the playthrough.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Can't be infected by Dragonrot.
- Purchasing the Floating Passage from him is necessary to unlock the Spiral Cloud Passage among the Mushin Esoteric Text Skill Tree, which in turn is needed to unlock the "Height of Technique" trophy.
- Sells one of the three pieces of the Dancing Dragon Mask, the other two fragments being sold by Pot Noble Koremori and the Dungeon Memorial Mob.
- If attacked, he'll stop talking to Wolf until the area is reloaded.
